dict.string: Read meeting titles locally and give a five-minute meeting warning. Vigil never changes your calendar.
On request, Vigil records a four-second question clip. Optional tired checks use one unsaved on-device frame only with your cover-open confirmation; on iPhone and iPad it also scans pairing codes.
Vigil pairs with your iPhone and iPad on the same Wi-Fi.
Listen for Vigil on this device and record audio only for your requested four-second camera clip.
Vigil recognises its name and your words on this device; speech audio is never uploaded.
